name: Bhagawati Oxygen Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1972, Bhagawati Oxygen Ltd is a manufacturing and engineering company with core focus on industrial gas manufacturing, technology, system, and equipment.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) BOL is engaged in manufacturing and selling oxygen gas, trading Sulfur Hexafluoride (SF6), and running a windmill. 
b) The company has a contract with Hindustan Copper Limited for selling
 oxygen gas.
c) It has warehouses for Sulfur Hexafluoride in West Bengal and Gujarat. 
d) The company is running a windmill at Tirunelveli in Tamil Nadu, from which it receives income from electricity generation.
e) Currently, BOL deals in the sale of gases and power.

cons: Stock is trading at 2.51 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -23.0% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -63.4% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 1,230 days.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
